name: Rovo Dev CLI
description: Rovo Dev CLI is Atlassian's agentic AI coding assistant that runs in the terminal with deep Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket integration via the Teamwork Graph.
author: Atlassian

commands.linux: curl -LO "https://acli.atlassian.com/linux/latest/acli_linux_$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/' | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/')/acli" && chmod +x ./acli && sudo mv ./acli /usr/local/bin/acli
commands.darwin: brew tap atlassian/homebrew-acli && brew install acli

terminalCommand.linux: x-terminal-emulator -e bash -c 'cd {dir} && exec acli rovodev run'
terminalCommand.darwin: open -a Terminal.app bash -c 'cd {dir} && exec acli rovodev run'
